name: Jounouchi Kouhei
source:
Sex: Male
Occupation: High School Teacher
Curse Echo: [spoiler]None[/spoiler]

Kohei is an English teacher and the homeroom teacher for Class 2C at Komagata High School. He was seen alone with [url=/c124647]Hitomi Okuda[/url] in a classroom late at night by [url=/c124611]Yakko[/url] and [url=/c124612]Mio[/url].
[spoiler]His deceased body was discovered on the school grounds at dawn.[/spoiler]
* * *
Kohei was an honor student and top of his class back in his high school days. The apple of his parents' eyes, he was placed under immense pressure to attend a first-rate university. The family's plans came to naught, however, when the pressure caused Kohei to sink into a deep depression and fail his entrance exam. Even at the university he was able to enter, Kohei struggled to keep up with his classes, leaving him a vain but wounded young man.
Kohei never aspired to be a teacher, but figured it was the least he could do with his talents. He considers his students to be beneath him, and largely looks down on them all.

[From in-game Persons of Interest profile]

[spoiler]Jonouchi witnessed [url=/c124637]Michiyo Shiraishi[/url] kidnap [url=/c124641]Shuichi Shigima[/url] a year ago, and with that he blackmailed Michiyo into having a sexual relationship with him. Following Michiyo's death, she possessed Yakko's body and used her curse stone to kill Jonouchi as revenge.[/spoiler]
